blocks.html:
Colorado First-Time Homebuyer Program

First-Time Homebuyer Grants Are Available in Colorado

Are you hoping to become a homeowner but don’t know where to start? Christine at The Little Lady Sells Homes is dedicated to helping first-time homebuyers achieve their dream of homeownership. With her expertise and guidance, many clients have been able to purchase homes using down payment assistance programs and receive $500 toward closing costs.

How Christine Can Help You:

  • Down Payment Assistance: Access programs that provide financial assistance to help you with your down payment.
  • $500 Toward Closing Costs: Receive a financial boost to cover some of your closing costs.
  • Personalized Guidance: Christine offers one-on-one consultations to help you understand the home buying process, from pre-approval to closing.

Join Our First-Time Homebuyer Seminars:

Christine hosts regular seminars covering essential topics like pre-approval, credit scores, finding the right home, negotiating, and closing deals. These seminars are a great way to learn about the home buying process in a supportive environment.

Veteran Home Purchase Program

Your VA Loan Specialist in Northern Colorado

Are you a veteran, active-duty service member, or military family looking to buy a home in Northern Colorado? Christine, the founder of The Little Lady Sells Homes, specializes in VA loans and is committed to serving our nation’s heroes. With over 25 years of real estate experience and a personal connection to the military community, Christine is here to make your home buying journey as smooth as possible.

Why Choose Christine for Your VA Home Loan Needs?

  • Deep Understanding of VA Loans: As a child and grandchild of veterans, Christine understands the unique challenges and benefits of VA home loans.
  • Local Expertise: Christine has extensive knowledge of Northern Colorado, including Fort Collins, Loveland, Greeley, and Eaton, helping you find the perfect home.
  • Experience You Can Trust: Over 25% of Christine’s transactions are dedicated to helping veterans, ensuring you receive top-notch service.

Special Offer for Veterans:

To show appreciation for your service, Christine offers $500 to assist with closing costs, making homeownership more accessible for those who have served our country.

Colorado Teacher Home Buying Grants

Supporting Educators in Northern Colorado

As a former teacher of 23 years, Christine has a special place in her heart for educators. She understands the challenges teachers face in affording a home, especially with rising home prices outpacing teaching salaries. To help, Christine offers a $1,000 incentive to teacher clients to assist with closing costs or down payments.

Additional Resources for Teachers:

  • Salary Information: Christine has compiled Northern Colorado teacher salary schedules in one place, helping current or future teachers learn more about various school districts.
  • Local Programs: Some cities and school districts, such as Greeley and School District 6, offer additional programs to assist educators. For example, Greeley’s G-Hope program provides support for buying homes with little to no down payment.
